Body.Content:
What and why

We are retiring selected Search Analytics capabilities for the following search experiences:

  • Microsoft/Bing Search, including Work Search
  • Teams Search
  • Outlook/WXP Search, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Windows Search Work results
  • Microsoft365.com

This retirement applies to Summary, User/Query, and Answer Analytics associated with these search experiences within Search & intelligence > Insights in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This change is limited to the analytics capabilities listed above. It does not:

  • Retire the Search & intelligence > Insights experience as a whole
  • Affect SharePoint Search Analytics
  • Affect Connector Analytics
  • Change users' ability to search in any of the affected applications

Rollout schedule

  • Worldwide, GCC: Rollout will begin in late November 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-December 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Administrators who use Summary, User/Query, or Answer Analytics for the affected search experiences.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft 365 admin center, Search & intelligence > Insights
  • Microsoft/Bing Search, including Work Search
  • Teams Search
  • Outlook/WXP Search, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Windows Search Work results
  • Microsoft365.com

What will happen

  • After the retirement reaches your tenant, administrators will no longer be able to access Summary, User/Query, or Answer Analytics for the affected search experiences.
  • Other Search Analytics capabilities not listed in this notice remain outside the scope of this retirement.
  • SharePoint Search Analytics and Connector Analytics are not affected.
  • Users' ability to search in the affected applications will not change.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required if your organization does not use these analytics capabilities. Otherwise, we recommend that you:

  • Review whether your organization relies on the affected Summary, User/Query, or Answer Analytics reports.
  • Identify administrators or reporting stakeholders who use these reports, filters, exports, or related reporting integrations.
  • Export or retain any required analytics data before retirement, subject to the confirmed historical-data availability.
  • Update any reporting processes or integrations that depend on the affected analytics capabilities.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: Selected Search Analytics capabilities for Microsoft/Bing, Teams, Outlook/WXP, Windows Search Work results, and Microsoft365.com will retire in late 2026. Summary, User/Query, and Answer Analytics in Microsoft 365 admin center will be removed, but search functions and other analytics remain unaffected. Administrators should review and export needed data.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Retirement of selected Search Analytics capabilities
